status: proposed specification; no model conformance implied
rule: Disposition every row; expand repeated rows against explicit inventories; no unchecked omissions or self-approved exceptions.

items.acceptance: Record all known identifiers associated with the topic, subject, entity, agent or actor, with scheme, assigning source/authority, scope, provenance, validity and association status. A local record reference is not the complete identifier set; support several without inventing unknown values.

items.deliverable: Referent, definition, instance, part and release identifier mappings
items.acceptance: Distinguish subjects of identifier associations, including taxon concept, organism/design/instance, parts, versions, package releases and content digests. Preserve qualified alternate/historical mappings and disagreements; matching labels or strings do not establish universal equivalence.
Enumerate the complete organism/thing, internal/external parts, attachments and independent review units.
Film, open-world game and cartoon each have a declared style, use, target runtime/output, inspection distance and acceptance criteria.
Enumerate evidenced stage, season, sex/phenotype/reproductive form or design/configuration variants; mark unknowns and valid combinations.

items.deliverable: Movement, behaviour, interaction and state inventories
items.acceptance: Research and enumerate the full applicable known repertoire for this subject; unresolved coverage gaps remain open rather than hidden.
Every normative requirement and catalogue row maps to delivery evidence or a reasoned, independently authorized inapplicability decision.
Add missing subject-specific deliverables, freeze the baseline and retain additions/retirements; no scope reduction to reach done.
Identify acquired/held datasets, source revisions, references, acquisition times and coverage.
Preserve taxon concepts/names or artefact types/designs; conflicting and historical identifications remain attributable.
Account for every available in-scope graph partition at the corpus revision; record omissions, restrictions and unresolved conflicts.
Pack interpretation context, term mappings, required vocabulary versions and shapes for native offline queries.
Store sourced units, bounds/distributions, uncertainty and distinction between species/design values and individual observations.
Named organs, parts, tissues, systems and functions resolve to the same component IDs used in representations.
Preserve observation/validity times, environmental context, spatial frames and sensitive-place conditions.
Represent applicable partner entities and relation evidence without flattening them into appearance metadata.
Available lifecycle, behaviour or operational facts, conditions and limitations belong in the graph, including facts unused by graphics.

items.deliverable: Rights, consent, attribution and source licences
items.acceptance: Each source/resource declares its rights and access conditions; a public derivative declares restricted exclusions honestly.
Every material assertion is distinguishable as observed, sourced, simulated, inferred, generated or illustrative with uncertainty.
Queries extract identifiers, parts, traits, relevant relations, available actions and representations from the actual packed graph offline.
Retain native editable geometry/procedural/CAD source, layers/history/parameters and semantic part bindings; compiled mesh alone is insufficient.
Sourced orthographic/diagnostic references and proportional studies support the intended subject and style.
Name actual native tools, library/API versions and supported features; separate source-present from runtime-qualified.
Source-to-output operations, inputs, seeds and receipts reproduce the artifact without required JS/Node/V8.
Record every conversion, source digest, units, hierarchy/rig/material retention and any unsupported or lost data.
A qualified native tool reopens and edits the source; undo/cancellation preserves work and the rebuilt part remains identifiable.
Changing one part, material or rule rebuilds affected outputs only and invalidates dependent evidence explicitly.
Each profile/variant records its source/parameter basis and deliberate deviations; no untraceable independently generated lookalike.

items.deliverable: Metric dimensions, axes, pivot and frame
items.acceptance: Author and runtime transforms preserve sourced physical dimensions; microscopic scale is explicit, viewport fitting does not change size.
Subject is recognizable without labels in multiple views at declared distances and matches relevant diagnostic structure.
Trunk/branches/leaves or body/limbs/shell or chassis/envelope/parts are present with meaningful joins and shape hierarchy.
Claimed anatomy, internal structure, equipment/interiors and cut surfaces contain useful detail and correct membership.
Finite geometry, winding, degeneracy, manifold requirements and declared exceptions are checked; accidental gaps/intersections are resolved.
Shading frames remain correct across mirrored UVs, hard edges, deformations and transforms.
Declare seams, density, tiling/atlas/procedural coordinates and sampling; no accidental stretching or unreported conversion.
Named parts attach in a consistent frame with no visible disconnection or transform duplication; removable parts preserve identifiers.
Required small detail uses an evidenced geometry/procedural/displacement/groom method that survives the intended inspection.
Qualified collision proxies, clearances, bounds and part selection agree with dimensions and motion, with declared error.
Distinguish applicable bark/leaf/wood/fur/skin/eye, paint/metal/rubber/glass/cloth and cut tissues by part and appearance.
Keep layered maps, nodes or recipes/parameters, source captures and deterministic seeds needed to recreate each surface.
Declare colour/data space, units, channels, normal convention, UV set, sampler, mip/compression and integrity for all maps.
Physical composition/response and render shading parameters are separately sourced and linked to matching parts.
Neutral, directional/backlit and habitat/production light reveal convincing distinct surfaces without clipped or featureless shading.
Applicable leaf/glass/membrane/hair/feather coverage, sidedness and shadow response work at intended scales.
Applicable wetness, age, seasonal, injury, weathering and repair states follow the same admitted state and part identifiers.
Source, working and output spaces, exposure and display transforms are declared and tested without accidental double conversion.
No dominant tiling, stretched detail, seams, mask halos or unacceptable shimmer at target distances and motion.
Native inspection proves actual required bindings/residency; missing/wrong-role maps are explicit failures, not silent fidelity success.
Declare intended closeups, camera/lens, shot distance, output size/rate, colour/dynamic range and temporal/quality tolerances.
High-detail source, surfaces and silhouette remain convincing at the specified closest shot; geometry/detail method and limits are evidenced.
Required joints, face, muscle, skin, fur/feather/cloth/foliage dynamics and caches support film poses without artifacts.
Qualify the needed lighting, shadows, transmission, displacement/groom, compositing passes and effects; unimplemented capabilities stay open.
Test movement, shutter/motion blur, sampling/noise, denoise and temporal stability where used, at the declared shot settings.
Retain scene/light/camera/time/seed/dependency setup, frame outputs, costs and colour metadata tied to package/source digests.
FilmCraft or qualified native sequence workflow reopens rendered shots/passes and sound with correct rational time and colour interpretation.
Every inventoried applicable clip/action/state has film-compatible rendering/deformation coverage or an unresolved delivery gap.
Review neutral turntable, diagnostic closeups and continuous action shots at final settings; human visual acceptance names the exact output.
Declare target hardware/native backend, view distances, instance density and measured frame/memory/transfer budgets; no universal guessed budget.
Derived levels have explicit error/detail bounds and compatible topology/material/rig/collision variants; preserve diagnostic features.
Distance/hysteresis transitions preserve volume, coverage, part/state identifiers and picking; impostor/proxy behavior is declared.
Native bounded acquisition/admission, culling and instancing retain individual identifiers; exercise actual populated-world conditions.
Collision, joints, traversal/navigation, reach/seat/grab/use and obstacle/contact behavior work at physical scale as applicable.
Reduced rig/update/simulation work preserves authoritative state and required events; distant visibility does not silently stop essential life/operation.
Position, terrain/shore contact, camera/depth, lighting and origin changes remain stable at declared world extent.
Measure cold/warm load, CPU/GPU frame distributions, residency, uploads and recovery; test device loss, exhaustion and stale replacement.
Unload/reload, checkpoint and permitted representation swaps preserve admitted instance state and compatible journals.
Human reviews walking/drive/inspect distances, a populated habitat and continuous interactions on declared native hardware.

items.deliverable: Cartoon design bible and delivery target
items.acceptance: Define coherent shape language, proportions, palette, shading/line treatment and film/realtime use; cartoon is not merely a low LOD.
Purpose-designed geometry/materials read clearly at declared distances and retain recognizable subject features.
Declare exaggerated/omitted detail and physical/interaction implications; stylization does not rewrite species/design facts or state.

items.deliverable: Cartoon rig, shapes and pose language
items.acceptance: Required squash/stretch, bend, facial/expression or mechanical stylization has controlled semantic/collision mappings and stable extreme poses.
All applicable inventoried movements/actions have deliberate timing, contacts, poses, anticipation/follow-through and transition coverage.
Qualified native shading/outlines/quantization retain readable form without temporal line/shadow flicker or inconsistent cuts.
Declare budgets/output settings and test rigs/materials/LOD for its film or game target; share valid resources without mixing incompatible profiles.
Review turntable, expression/pose sheet and continuous action sequence within the intended coherent scene style.
Enumerate skeletal, rigid-joint, morph, procedural, growth and secondary mechanisms; a static prop requires an explicit reviewed reason.
Stable joints/parts, frames, limits and attachments match anatomy/design; retain editable controls and authored bind/rest state.
Weights, joint mapping, influence limits and deformation topology meet the chosen profile without leaking/collapsing parts.
Required feet/hands/tail/wheel/tool constraints and pose controls solve with stable contacts and intentional mode transitions.
Applicable joint correctives, eyelids/mouth/digits, muscle or mechanical seals are authored and tied to named parts/states.
Exercise representative and worst allowed poses for every rig/profile, including normals/tangents and visible volume preservation.
Declare and qualify joint/clip mappings, scale changes and excluded combinations without silently retargeting incompatible anatomy.
Animated geometry, bounds, shadows, collision proxies and semantic picks agree throughout allowed motion.

items.deliverable: Secondary dynamics and baked/procedural cache policy
items.acceptance: Applicable foliage/cloth/fur/feather/antenna/cable/suspension dynamics have controlled parameters, budgets, collision and deterministic inputs.
Native tools discover and manipulate the actual rig and clips; pause, seek, edit, interruption and reset preserve coherent state.
Catalogue all known applicable movement modes and contexts for the subject, including stationary and rare/recovery movement; source or label assumptions.

items.deliverable: Idle, rest and secondary living/operating motion
items.acceptance: Applicable breathing, gaze, ear/eye motion, settling, leaf/wind, vibration or running machinery has intentional state-linked presentation.
For each inventoried mode author required start/cruise/stop/reverse/turn/speed/direction forms, or expose the precise missing coverage.
Applicable jump/hop/climb/swim/fly/burrow/slither/crawl, door/wheel/suspension/actuator or plant tropic/wind motion is represented and qualified.
Clips declare duration/rate/looping, contact phases, action events and exact timing; events drive the correct named subject parts.
Distinguish presentation from admitted movement; speed, turning, slope, traction and collision agree without foot/wheel/tail sliding.
Every allowed state/clip edge is implemented/tested, including entry/exit, interruption, reverse/seek and denied transitions.
Compatible actors/objects align contact, reach, feed/grasp/use/board/social events and separate each participant's state authority.

items.deliverable: Injury, fault, recovery and lifecycle movement
items.acceptance: Applicable impairment, stumble/stall, shutdown/death, recovery/restart and stage changes are represented without fake physiological/operational claims.
Every compatible variant/profile/LOD action is listed as delivered, shared with evidence, blocked or unavailable; no claim from one tested clip to the whole library.
Continuous sequences show real transitions/contacts from the admitted runtime; keep input/time/seed and source/clip identifiers for reproduction.
Alternative presentation preserves important action/state information and timing without claiming absent motion.
Discover all known applicable actions, states, needs/controls and interactions from the packed graph; distinguish authored policy, observations and unknowns.
Each behaviour declares participants, trigger/stimulus, allowed states/environment/variants, units, outputs, refusals and consequences.
Actual named rules/capabilities implement each action; UI/animation is not an independent state engine.
Applicable food/water/nutrients/energy/fuel/material intake, storage, consumption and waste/output are accounted for under sourced assumptions.
Applicable light, sound, temperature, moisture, terrain, threat or operator inputs change state under declared models; do not invent inner psychology.
Applicable communication, mating/care, group response, pollination or operator/multi-device interactions have compatible participant/state contracts.
Applicable stage/phenology/age changes drive coherent anatomy/rig/material/physics/behaviour; uniform scaling alone is not development.
Causal thresholds and resulting part/state/resource/appearance changes preserve loss/replacement lineage and irreversibility where modeled.
Recorded time, seed, event ordering and policy versions reproduce outcomes within declared numerical tolerances.
Single/qualified writer, versioned transactions, base binding, checkpoint/restore and causal events preserve immutable HMC definitions.
Admitted effects drive clips, poses, contacts, emitters and physical changes; decorative motion never claims resource transfer.
Exercise expected effect, missing inputs, wrong state, denied authority, cancellation, interruption and stale requests for every applicable behaviour.
Enumerate allowed/denied transitions and materially distinct contexts; each has evidence or an explicit open gap, including profile/variant differences.
What-if/review actions cannot mutate source or another session; replay/reset restores the documented state and releases old effects.
Represent the actual applicable organism habit, trunk/stem, roots/mycelium, branches and crown/fruiting-body structure; qualify taxon-specific assumptions.
Applicable leaf/bark/root/flower/bud/fruit/seed/spore/gill or other diagnostic organs and tissues have named, meaningful inspectable detail.
Applicable germination/emergence, juvenile/mature/reproductive/senescent/dead and propagation states have evidence and compatible representations.
Applicable budding, flowering/anthesis, fruiting, spore/seed release, leaf flush/drop and season changes are modeled/presented with sourced timing.

items.deliverable: Wind, touch, tropism and environmental motion
items.acceptance: Applicable trunk/branch/stem/leaf motion and response preserve attachments, scale, physical assumptions and profile compatibility.

items.deliverable: Water, nutrient, light and substrate processes
items.acceptance: Declare and qualify applicable uptake/growth/resource/environment coupling without confusing a simplified model with measured physiology.
Applicable breakage, drought/wilting, disease/fire response, regrowth and death preserve causal/state/component consistency.
Available host/symbiosis/pollination/food/habitat relations and placement conditions are represented with sourced applicability, not random taxon colour cycling.
Skeletal/soft-tissue landmarks, limb/digit/head/tail/wing and coat/covering features identify the species and support plausible poses.
Inventory subject-appropriate gaits/modes, turning, slopes, terrain/water/air transitions, speed ranges and contacts, including unusual species-specific modes.
Applicable foraging/capture/chewing/swallow/drink/digest/output actions have coherent contacts, resources and presentation.
Applicable sleeping/resting/grooming, gaze/sensory response, calls and body signals are covered and evidence-labelled.
Applicable group/social/threat/escape/defence/mating/nesting/parental actions have source/context, compatible participants and noninvented effects.
Available dimorphism, juvenile/mature/ageing and reproductive-condition morphology/rig/behaviour compatibility is explicit.

items.deliverable: Injury, illness, death and recovery forms
items.acceptance: Applicable impairment/stress/recovery and death states preserve anatomy, physical contacts, behaviour limitations and evidence boundaries.
Available home/habitat/resource/food-web/host interactions drive only qualified behaviour and contextual placement.

groups.title: Vehicle, structure, tool and system supplement

items.acceptance: Design revision, manufactured/synthetic instance and actual configuration/observations have separate identifiers and provenance.
Specified/actual quantities, material batches, replaceable parts, structural parents, attachment frames and configuration history are retained.
Applicable wheels, steering, suspension, hinges/doors, actuators, mechanisms, service spaces and interiors have dimensions/limits/contact.
Mechanical/electrical/fluid/thermal/data interfaces declare medium, units, compatibility, ratings and actual state; containment and functional loops are distinct.
Start/stop/idle/operate/reverse/configure or other applicable modes expose controls, preconditions, feedback and exact state changes.

items.deliverable: Energy, fluid, material and thermal accounting
items.acceptance: Inputs/stores/outputs/losses, capacities, consumption and temperature models are sourced and budgeted; rated performance is not observed flow.
Applicable wear, fatigue, corrosion, impact, overheating, leaks or faults produce coherent operation/appearance/part consequences.
Declared work uses inputs/tools/parts, removes/adds actual component identifiers, records condition/configuration and preserves reuse/disposal lineage.
Location, anchors, service connection/disconnection and relocation remain distinct from manufacturing identifiers and compatible state.
Use/control/maintenance/custody/ownership claims are explicit; occupants/operators are agents, never manufactured parts or owned contents.
Required design/section/exploded/system and film/game/cartoon depictions resolve to matching assembly/part state and record simplifications.
Exercise normal operation, wrong units/connections, insufficient supply, stale configuration, denied control and a failure/repair/restart sequence.
Distinguish organism, colony, cell, organelle, molecule and explanatory model; include physical units, time scale and evidence limits.
Applicable membranes, walls, appendages, organelles, molecular/colony structures and sections have sourced identifiers and meaningful inspection.
Applicable motility, transport, metabolism/reaction and response modes have declared models and presentation at meaningful temporal scales.
Available growth, division, differentiation, reproduction and death/decay states preserve lineage and distinguish observed from modeled dynamics.
Scientific, film/game and cartoon abstractions retain entity identifiers; simulations/fields have sourced parameters, valid regimes and required verification.
Native inspection traverses the correct part/scale relations and resources without treating magnification as physical growth or graph facts as mesh detail.

groups.title: Natural body, terrain and habitat supplement

items.deliverable: Natural referent, frame and source coverage
items.acceptance: Distinguish measured/place-specific from illustrative landform/material/habitat; declare geospatial frame, resolution, time, provenance and uncertainty.
Applicable terrain, rocks, soil/substrate, water and internal layers have meaningful geometry/material/field representations and source-derived boundaries.
Species/artefact instances retain their own embodiments; composition respects ecological/contextual constraints, physical contact and declared density.
Applicable erosion/fracture/flow/wave/soil/weather or other declared dynamics link parameters, mass/energy accounting and stable visual response.
Declared world-to-closeup transitions retain coordinates, topology/coverage, contacts and picking without tile seams or physical-scale compression.
Review representative walk/inspect/film/cartoon sequences and applicable environment interactions using identified graph and model inputs.
Distinguish fictional avatar from a real human; preserve applicable identifiers, capture/biometric consent and privacy, without invented authority.
Applicable proportions, face/hands/feet, clothing layers and equipment are credible, deformable and linked to appropriate entity/part/attachment identifiers.

items.deliverable: Human locomotion, gestures and task contacts
items.acceptance: Inventoried movement, grasp/use/carry/sit/board and social/task interactions have stable contacts and authored expression/timing for required targets.
Applicable face/lip/voice/gesture synchronization uses licensed sources and explicit fictional/real scope, with text and reduced-motion alternatives.
Actions, role/permission and scenario policy are declared; animation or inference never claims observed intent, consent or psychological truth.
People remain agents with applicable standing; clothing/tools/vehicles and occupancy do not turn the person into an owned assembly component.
Declare static/kinematic/rigid/articulated/deformable/field or other model, version, bounds and approximation; unknown does not mean indestructible.
Source and validate applicable typed physical quantities, centre of mass and density without treating AABB volume as measured matter.
Qualified proxies and coefficients support intended interactions with stable contacts, material units and constrained motion.

items.deliverable: Gravity, terrain, wind, water and buoyancy
items.acceptance: Applicable environment coupling has explicit inputs, scales, boundary conditions and stable response on the actual subject.
Applicable response facets have sourced parameters and units; unsupported responses remain declared limitations.
Applicable break/bend/burn/tear/dissolve/fail transitions tie cause and units to resulting parts, conserved/accounted resources and state.
Declare solver, timestep, tolerances, accounted quantities and stability limits; replay and stress cases use the actual selected solver.
If operational twin is claimed, identify real referent, observations, calibration/synchronization/staleness and held-out validation; illustration cannot qualify it.
Catalogue applicable calls, movement/contact, operation/fault, environmental response, images/video/plates and their provenance.
Retain native source sessions, samples/synthesis parameters, edits, stems and output settings; generated sound is labelled as such.
Sounds/media bind to actual parts/actions/state with timing, loop/variation and environment applicability.
Qualified sample rate, levels, channels, spatial response/occlusion and sync work on declared native playback; no clicks, drift or orphan emitters.
Provide text/labels/captions and keyboard/discoverable controls; essential identifiers/state is not only colour, sound or motion.

items.deliverable: Media rights, bounded residency and unload
items.acceptance: Encoded media is licensed, verified, budgeted and released on unload; required unavailable media is not hidden as a complete package.
Package the whole declared species or made-world embodiment, with entity/release identifiers, codec/schema/profile versions and source lineage.
Actual Q42 entries match reconciled available corpus, lexicon/vocabulary/shapes/provenance and access partition declarations.

items.deliverable: Root, part, profile and variant discovery
items.acceptance: Native engine enumerates complete logical roots, components, representations and compatible combinations from the package itself.
Entries, roles, digests, sizes, shared resources, sources, rule/media/rig/material dependencies and required/optional distinctions reconcile.
Run qualified HMC and interior-format checks over actual final bytes; hashes alone do not establish semantics, authorship or visual validity.

items.deliverable: Selective native admission and graph use
items.acceptance: Query graph, plan resource closure and admit a selected whole root without loading all alternatives or the game; state/pick identifiers survives swaps.
Required graph/resources/terms and declared operations work without external DNS/network dependencies; explicit extensions bind exact bases.
Source HMC remains immutable; observations, simulation, review and user state have explicit ownership/base compatibility and durability.
Corrupt/missing/cyclic/incompatible resources, exhausted budgets, stale results and interrupted loads retain the last admitted object and user work.
HMC exposes the per-resource rights and truthful per-deliverable claim/evidence status; no fabricated signatures or human approval.

items.deliverable: Rebuild, version migration and rollback compatibility
items.acceptance: Native rebuild and permitted upgrades preserve IDs/state and record schema/resource migration or explicit refusal without rewriting old releases.
Reviewer inspects actual decoded facts, parts, operation and all three representations using identified package bytes and public engine APIs.
Record source/tool/library/binary/package identifiers, host/backend/device, settings, budgets, input/seed/time and actual invocation path.
Disposition every catalogue row and every inventoried part/clip/behaviour/profile case; no missing/duplicate/vacuous/stale claims.
Evidence distinguishes source inspection, compile, executed check, runtime result and scope; failed/unexecuted checks remain visible.

items.deliverable: Human visual acceptance of three profiles
items.acceptance: Authorized reviewer accepts exact film, game and cartoon artifacts against declared criteria, including required movement and scene use.
Required expert/domain review accepts claim scope, diagnostics/proportions/anatomy or mechanical/operational correspondence, and remaining uncertainty.
Record applicable independent rights, accessibility and listening/media review results with actual evidence and authority.
Evidence binds exact output/input/dependency/settings digests; changes reopen affected claims and stale acceptance is never inherited silently.

items.deliverable: Declared limitations and authorized applicability decisions
items.acceptance: Every unknown, blocked, partial, failed or proposed exclusion is reported; no agent self-waiver, target removal or invented completion percentage.
Independent gate checks all applicable rows/expansions/evidence/reviews and three target profiles; final report states complete only if no required work remains.
Retain editable source, HMC, inventories, claims, evidence/review references and native reproduction instructions; no publication or signing is inferred.
